_comment: Showcase recording of the DevOps Pipeline (sfdx-hardis-pipeline-view.gif): one Pull Request of the MyCompany-CRM universe, from review to deployed, with its deployment actions. The recording test adds it to the base fixtures in temporary files, in three states (open, merged with its deployment running, deployed). The GitHub stills of the github folder are taken by scripts/capture-github-merge.js.

pullRequest.title: CRM-1070 Agentforce case triage agent
pullRequest.description:
A Case Triage agent reads every new case, finds its category and sends it to the right queue.

- New agent `Case_Triage_Agent` and its permission set
- `CaseTriageService` can be called by the agent

Agentforce must be activated before the deployment, and the agent after it: both are declared as deployment actions.

validation.body:
![🔍 Validation Results (deployment simulation)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hardisgroupcom/sfdx-hardis/refs/heads/main/docs/assets/images/pr-banner-validation-success.png) ### ✅ Ready to merge into `integration` The deployment was simulated in the `integration` org: nothing was changed there. | Check | Result | |-------|--------| | Metadata | ✅ 3 components would change (2 created, 1 updated), 3 validated | | Apex tests | ✅ Coverage 93% (target 75%) · 1 test class | | Deployment actions | 👋 1 to do by hand · 🕒 4 after the merge | | Quick Deploy | ✅ The merge job can reuse this validation: Apex tests will not run again | #### 👋 To do by hand in `integration` before the deployment - [ ] **Activate Agentforce in Setup** > Setup > Einstein Setup > turn on **Einstein**, then Setup > Agentforce Agents > turn on **Agentforce**. _Tick a box once it is done in the org: the next sfdx-hardis job records it._
🛠️ Deployment actions of this job (5) | | Action | When | Result | |:-:|--------|------|--------| | 👋 | Activate Agentforce in Setup | before | to do by hand | | ⚪ | Assign the Agentforce license to the agent user | before | skipped: Runs after the merge only | | ⚪ | Run the case triage backfill batch | after | skipped: Runs after the merge only | | ⚪ | Publish the Customer Portal | after | skipped: Runs after the merge only | | ⚪ | Activate the Case Triage agent in Agentforce Builder | after | skipped: Runs after the merge only |
